name: AIOStreams
description:
AIOStreams was created to give users ultimate control over their Stremio experience. Instead of juggling multiple addons with different configurations and limitations, AIOStreams acts as a central hub. It fetches results from all your configured sources, then deduplicates, filters, sorts, and formats them according to your rules before presenting them in a single, clean list.

Whether you're a casual user who wants a simple, unified stream list or a power user who wants to fine-tune every aspect of your results, AIOStreams has you covered.
author: Viren070
short_description: AIOStreams consolidates multiple Stremio addons and debrid/usenet services - including its own suite of built-in addons and a native Usenet streaming engine - into a single, highly customisable super-addon.

name: Aidoku Community Sources
description:
Aidoku Community Sources is a community-maintained project that provides a collection of sources for the Aidoku manga reader. These sources can be added to compatible versions of Aidoku and are designed to expand the application's available browsing options.

The project brings together community-developed sources in a centralized repository, making them easier to discover, install, and maintain. Contributors can also participate in the project by creating new sources or helping maintain existing ones.

As part of the wider Aidoku ecosystem, Aidoku Community Sources serves as a resource for users looking to extend and customize their browsing experience within the application.

name: UMA Plugin
description:
UMA Plugin is a community-developed extension for compatible anime and manga applications. It is designed to provide additional functionality within the supported application ecosystem.

The plugin serves as an optional addition for users who want to extend their application's capabilities. Its features and compatibility depend on the implementation of the plugin and the applications that support it.

As a community-developed project, UMA Plugin contributes to the wider ecosystem of extensions and tools available for anime and manga applications.


1. Open app > go to Explore > Tap the 3 dots ⋮ > Manga Sources > Manage Plugins > press the + button.

2. Now choose one of these:

a. Import from Local → if you downloaded the .jar file

b. Import from GitHub → if you copied the GitHub URL

3. Lastly remember to enable "auto update plugins"
author: InvalidDavid
short_description: UMA Plugin is an extension for compatible anime and manga applications, providing additional functionality through a plugin-based system.
